test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 12 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following statement is correct?

I. The biggest state of India in terms of area is Uttar Pradesh.

II. Rajasthan is the state of India which have highest population among all other states of India.
solution:
Correct answer **Neither I nor II**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points:__**

__
 
• India is the 7th largest country in the world in terms of land area and also the largest country in terms of population.
 
• India has a total of 8 Union Territories and 28 states.
